info.bio: James Blake Litherland (Enfield, 26 de septiembre de 1988)1​ es un cantante, compositor, multiinstrumentista y productor discográfico inglés. Recibió reconocimiento por primera vez por una serie de EP de 2010, incluidos CMYK y Klavierwerke, y lanzó su álbum debut homónimo en 2011, recibiendo elogios de la crítica. Su segundo álbum, Overgrown, fue lanzado en 2013, atrayendo la atención internacional, y luego recibió el Premio Mercury.​ En 2016

podcast.title: Pioneer of a New Electronic Style (2010)
podcast.body: In the early 2010s, James Blake began developing a highly personal interpretation of electronic music that captured significant critical attention. His work was seen as the discovery of a new musical style and a novel approach to music creation, blending intimate singer-songwriter traditions with electronic sounds and very slow tempos. "En los primeros de esta década en el 2010 empieza a hacer una interpretación muy personal de la música electrónica que llama muchísimo la atención a la crítica."

srcs.episode: JAMES BLAKE. El mago del sonido.

podcast.title: Kanye West's Endorsement (2012)
podcast.body: In 2012, James Blake's popularity surged significantly after Kanye West publicly declared him his favorite artist. This endorsement instantly turned many into James Blake fans, greatly amplifying his public profile. "Otro punto que desató su popularidad fue en el 2012 cuando Cani West dijo que era su artista preferido y ahí todo el mundo se puso loco."

srcs.episode: JAMES BLAKE. El mago del sonido.

podcast.title: Alchemy of Natural Sound
podcast.body: Unlike a trend towards increasingly artificial sounds in electronic music, James Blake pursues the opposite extreme: processing sound to make it appear more natural and organic. He is seen as an "alchemist of sound" who brings audio processing to new levels of perfection, creating a perspective that is increasingly influencing others and may become a more common trend, as listeners seek organic sounds amidst artificiality. "James Blake ha conseguido ir al extremo completamente puesto, procesar cada vez más el sonido para que cada vez parezca más natural y más orgánico."

srcs.episode: JAMES BLAKE. El mago del sonido.

podcast.title: Boiler Room Regular
podcast.body: James Blake became a regular artist on Boiler Room as the platform expanded its reach beyond British borders, extending to Berlin and other global cities, and incorporating new styles. "Artistas como Jamie XX, Hudson Mojaco y James Blake se convirtieron en habituales."

srcs.episode: De Tiny Desk a Boiler Room: El Boom de los Conciertos en YouTube

podcast.title: Early Classical Training
podcast.body: From a young age, James Blake received a very classical musical education, studying solfège and piano and mastering various instruments. This strong classical background later influenced his unique electronic interpretations. "Desde joven tiene una formación muy clásica de música, la estudia sorfeo, estudia piano, toca muchos instrumentos."

srcs.episode: JAMES BLAKE. El mago del sonido.

podcast.title: Extensive Collaborations
podcast.body: Following his rise to prominence, James Blake has collaborated with numerous renowned artists due to his unique sound processing abilities. His collaborators include Kendrick Lamar, Beyoncé, Chance the Rapper, Brian Eno, Nicolas Jaar, Bon Iver, and Jack White. "Él ha colaborado con todo el mundo porque todo el mundo está procesado yo creo que así con colaborar con él."

srcs.episode: JAMES BLAKE. El mago del sonido.

podcast.title: Influence on Contemporary Music
podcast.body: James Blake is regarded as one of the most influential figures in contemporary music, including mainstream popular music. His slow, intimate electronic style has particularly impacted artists like Bon Iver and Nicolas Jaar, who belong to the same generation. "Yo creo que son uno de los tíos que más se ha influenciado la música actual hoy en día incluso la música de gran consumo."

srcs.episode: JAMES BLAKE. El mago del sonido.

podcast.title: King of Pitch Shifting
podcast.body: James Blake has become known as "the king of pitch shifting" for his sophisticated manipulation of audio speeds. He masterfully twists playback velocities, mixes different speeds, and creates wonderful effects across all his audio tracks. "Él es capaz de coger su música, coger todas sus pistas de audio, retorcer las velocidades de reproducción de manera complejísima, mezclar distintas velocidades de reproducción y generar efectos maravillosos."

srcs.episode: JAMES BLAKE. El mago del sonido.

podcast.title: Masterful Sound Processing
podcast.body: James Blake is hailed as a "sound wizard" and a "culinary master in musical form" for his unparalleled ability to process sound. He applies intricate, subtle, and elegant ultra-processing techniques to create sounds that are meticulously perfect, almost impossible, yet appear natural and organic. "Él es capaz de ultraprocesar el sonido de una manera muy elegante."

srcs.episode: JAMES BLAKE. El mago del sonido.

podcast.title: Reimagining UK Electronic Rhythms
podcast.body: A characteristic element of James Blake's style is his use of rhythmic bases heavily influenced by early 2000s UK electronic movements such as Dubstep, Trance, and Drum and Bass. He takes these often aggressive bases and reinterprets them in a completely new way, creating extremely slow, distinct rhythmic foundations that revitalize a genre previously thought to be exhausted. "Casi toda la base arrímica que usa el sonido elitónico. La toma de los movimientos británicos en primeros el 2000 del Duffstep, del Trustet, del Dragon Base."

srcs.episode: JAMES BLAKE. El mago del sonido.

podcast.title: Voice as an Instrument
podcast.body: James Blake employs highly complex methods to process his voice, often layering his vocals five or six times with different treatments. These processed vocal tracks can sound like instruments, female choirs, or variations in playback speed, achieving a unique texture that sometimes masks the origin of the sound. "A veces parece que son instrumentos cuando es su voz ultra procesada, a veces parece que son coros de mujeres y es su voz procesada."

srcs.episode: JAMES BLAKE. El mago del sonido.
